title: Andy & Megan · Greece 2027
eyebrow: Suites With Keith · Your 25th anniversary, Andy & Megan
meta: May 9 to 21, 2027 · Two travelers · Twelve nights
intro: Two nights at The Dolli under the Acropolis, a helicopter to Paros for four at Cosme, a private boat to Sifnos for three at Nos, then the caldera at Canaves Oia Suites to finish. No ferries anywhere, and home a full day before graduation.

route_note: All four hotels are booked; confirmations are in your inbox. A driver meets you at every airport, heliport and port.
days_intro: Everything between the hotels is arranged through Original Senses, my partner in Athens. Your own time is the rest of it.

days.title: Fly to Athens
days.note: Overnight from the US on the flights you book, landing the morning of May 9.

days.title: Arrive Athens
days.note: A driver meets you at arrivals and takes you to The Dolli. Rooftop pool, the Acropolis in front of you, one long dinner in Plaka.

days.title: Helicopter to Paros
days.note: About 41 minutes on an Airbus ACH135. The car collects you at The Dolli and meets you again at the Paros helipad.

days.title: Cosme, four nights
days.note: The beach club out front, Naoussa on foot and no car all week.

days.title: Private boat to Sifnos
days.note: The Goldfish 43 with your own crew and a swim stop at Antiparos, your luggage on board.

days.title: Nos, three nights
days.note: The quiet island: trails, tavernas and almost nobody in early May.

days.title: Helicopter to Santorini
days.note: About 26 minutes on a Bell 407, or a second boat day with swim stops if you would rather. Your call.

days.title: Canaves Oia Suites, three nights
days.note: The caldera as the finale, with your pool heated for May.

days.title: Fly home
days.note: Santorini to Athens to the US, landing the same day. I'll line the timing up to whatever you book.

stays.headline: The Dolli, the best-placed hotel in Athens
paras: Small, grown-up and right under the Acropolis. The rooftop at dusk is the right first night after the flight.
Two nights is enough to land, decompress and see the city properly before the islands.

card.label: Your room · 2 nights
rows: Athenian Room, marble bath, walk-in rain shower

img.caption: Cosme, above the beach at Naoussa

stays.headline: Cosme, the best beach stay on Paros
paras: Cosme is my pick for a beach stay on Paros. The base rooms are bigger than many hotels' junior suites, the private beach club sits right in front, and the circular spa and gym are some of the most interesting buildings on the island.
Naoussa is a short walk, so no car all week. Easy and laid-back after the Athens pace.

card.label: Your suite · 4 nights
rows: Full Gaia Suite, king, partial sea view balcony

img.caption: Nos, above the fishing village of Faros

stays.headline: Nos, the quiet island in the middle
paras: Nos is one of my favorite stays in the Cyclades: minimalist Cycladic architecture above the fishing village of Faros, facing east for sunrise, with your own plunge pool.
Sifnos is the island for two foodies who like a trail: clay-pot cooking, the Kastro to Chrysopigi coastal walk, and tavernas that are worth the trip on their own.

card.label: Your suite · 3 nights
rows: Junior Suite, sea view, plunge pool

img.alt: Canaves Oia Suites pool over the caldera
img.caption: Canaves Oia Suites, high on the caldera in Oia

stays.headline: Canaves Oia Suites, the caldera finale
paras: The nicest hotel on the caldera itself, higher up and more private than most of Oia, with panoramic sea views from the bed and the rain shower.
Canaves has confirmed your plunge pool can be heated for May, so it is a warm pool rather than a cold one.

card.label: Your suite · 3 nights
rows: Pool Suite, king, open-plan living room, veranda with loungers

ideas.heading: My pick
ideas.title: One more boat day, on Santorini
ideas.note: With the helicopter from Sifnos, one more day on the water is worth it. You'll already see the best of Paros and Antiparos on the boat to Sifnos, so I'd save it for the caldera. Either a full day of swimming at Red Beach, White Beach and the hot springs, finishing with the sunset off Oia, or a half day: a morning sail when the water is calmest, or an evening one timed to the sunset.

ideas.heading: Santorini
ideas.title: Wine tasting and a long lunch
ideas.note: An afternoon at a couple of the island's best wineries, tasting the volcanic Assyrtiko the island is known for, with a long lunch looking out over the caldera. A driver takes you there and back.

ideas.heading: Paros and Santorini
ideas.title: Beach clubs and dinner tables
ideas.note: Day beds at the beach clubs and the dinners worth dressing up for. Once the books open for the 2027 season, I'll reserve the ones you want so there's nothing to chase while you're there.
